sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.9.91

  • All Forms Submissions Route & Funnel Aggregation: Added REST API route GET /cora/v1/forms/submissions to aggregate submissions across all forms. Updated Advanced Funnel Analytics tab to fetch and aggregate field completion rates across all forms when 'All Forms' is selected.

2.9.90

  • All Forms Submissions Route & Funnel Aggregation: Added REST API route GET /cora/v1/forms/submissions to aggregate submissions across all forms. Updated Advanced Funnel Analytics tab to fetch and aggregate field completion rates across all forms when 'All Forms' is selected.

2.9.89

  • Forms Builder & UPI Payments Overhaul: Fixed async popup window blocking on View button click by pre-opening blank tab synchronously before auto-saving draft; added UPI ID and UPI QR payment field types with live canvas preview and public checkout rendering; updated field sidebar (removed PRO badge, added UPI fields); added inline block insertion divider buttons; fixed hash navigation redirect after publish.

2.9.88

  • Forms Module & Header Polish: Fixed REST API subpath routing with dynamic getCoraRestUrl(), added explicit Save Draft button with Unsaved Draft status indicator, auto-save before back navigation, and fixed desktop sidebar top margin gap.

2.9.87

  • Forms Module REST API Routing & Unsaved Draft Preview Fix: Replaced hardcoded root-relative REST API URLs with dynamic getCoraRestUrl() resolution to prevent 404 errors on subpath sites (e.g. app.heycora.in/test-1/). Added seamless auto-publish pipeline when clicking View or Share on unsaved form drafts.

2.9.86

  • E-Sign Base64 Signature Image Escaping Fix: Replaced esc_url() sanitization with esc_attr() in public-doc-view.php signature card stamp containers. Fixes a bug where WordPress esc_url() stripped base64 data URIs (data:image/png;base64,...) resulting in empty image src attributes on shared document links.

2.9.85

  • SMTP Relay SSL Bypass & Default Option Fallback: Added SSL certificate verification bypass to PHPMailer settings in cora_configure_phpmailer_smtp and fallback for cora_smtp_enabled in cora_get_default_smtp_settings() to ensure seamless email delivery across environments.

2.9.84

  • Direct E-Sign Email Sharing Fix: Wired the Share Document Access modal's 'Send' button to execute the cora_share_document_email AJAX controller, generating secure client access hashes and dispatching signature request emails.

2.9.83

  • Workspace Editor Redirect: Configured Edit Studio to directly load step 3 (Build Document) of the document wizard instead of step 1 (blueprint selector) for existing documents, bypassing configuration setup steps.

2.9.82

  • Security & Tenant Stability Improvements: Relaxed settings in-app updater capability checks to allow Workspace Owners and Super Admins manual update checks. Added SSL verification bypass to remote update checkers. Resolved e-signature validation token errors for guests under multi-tenant isolation filters.

2.9.81

  • Client-Side Performance Optimization & CDN Asset Localization: Localized all external render-blocking CDN resources (QuillJS, ChartJS, TomSelect, CodeMirror, Tailwind CSS, jQuery, and Canvas Confetti) inside the plugin assets directory and applied async/defer execution tags. This resolves page parsing blockages, mitigates external DNS/SSL lookup timeouts, and enables native-like load speeds for the Workspace.

2.9.80

  • Public Secure Share Link Generation: Upgraded document share modal and share drawer to generate public secure links of the form /shared-doc/{hash} instead of dashboard links requiring login. Enforced automatic secured shares setup on document creation and page load fallback so shared files are immediately viewable by clients without authentication.

2.9.79

  • SEO & GEO Rank Drop Monitoring Trigger: Implemented daily rank monitoring check (10:00 AM) that tracks target keyword SERP positions and AI citations. Added automated, monochromatic alert email dispatches to Workspace Owners. Cleaned up emoji tags in automation subjects, registered the daily cron schedules, and integrated rank-drop check manual tests in the AJAX suite.

2.9.78

  • Mobile Layout & Width Constraint Optimizations: Integrated strict layout constraints (w-full max-w-full) and dynamic flex stretch/items alignment across the SEO Analyzer panel, layout wrapper, and main analysis area. Fixed card overflow and badge clipping on mobile viewports.

2.9.77

  • Sidebar Top Group Label Spacing & Padding Optimization: Reduced excess top margin on .cora-nav-group-label and eliminated top margin for the first navigation group sitting directly underneath the sidebar search bar, creating a clean, tight, and compact transition into the navigation menu.

2.9.76

  • Automated Owner Digests & Security Alert Control Suite: Built autonomous email automation engine delivering Morning Operational Kickoff Briefs (08:30 AM), Mid-Day Geofence Anomaly Audits (14:00 PM), Evening Business Intelligence KPI Summaries (18:00 PM), Real-Time Security & Role Elevation Alerts, and Sunday Payroll Preparation Digests directly to Workspace Owners without manual checking. Added new Automated Digests & Alerts control tab inside User Management with real-time toggle switches and on-demand test dispatch functionality.

2.9.75

  • Mobile Layout & Structure Overhaul: Re-engineered Attendance Logs filter toolbar with compact inline search bar and collapsible mobile filter panel. Removed horizontal swipe tracks on mobile Permissions Matrix and converted role cards into a vertical stacked grid. Aligned matrix action buttons into a clean 3-column row grid on mobile.

2.9.74

  • Mobile UI & Scroll Overhaul: Fully resolved vertical scroll locking on mobile viewports. Replaced all invalid zinc-150 border tokens with standard system borders to eliminate black outlines. Built a premium swipeable cards UI for the Permissions Matrix with collapsible category accordions, and optimized the Attendance Logs stats widgets into a 2x2 grid. All local Playwright E2E tests verified and passed.

2.9.73

  • Dynamic Roles & Mismatch Resolution: Upgraded the user management module, registration forms, email notifications, audit logs, and universal search category subtitles to resolve dynamically created custom roles to their human-readable labels instead of raw system keys. Verified and passed all local and remote E2E tests.

2.9.72

  • Staging & E2E Testing Synchronization: Verified clean Custom Roles addition/deletion operations, Permissions Matrix autosaves, and dynamic industry-scoped label swaps on the remote staging environment (app.heycora.in) with 100% passing E2E Playwright test assertions.

2.9.71

  • Custom Roles E2E Verification: Created and verified local custom roles E2E test suite covering addition, editing, duplication, deletion, and dynamic industry-scoped accessibility labels in both Real Estate and Photography Studio workspaces.

2.9.70

  • Custom Roles AJAX Hooks Alignment: Resolved AJAX hook mismatch by registering all variations (e.g. wp_ajax_cora_ajax_add_custom_role) matching client JS $.post requests, and cleaned up legacy duplicate delete declarations while keeping tenant-scoped option keys.
  • Dynamic Industry-Scoped Feature Accessibility: Converted permissions checkboxes in Create/Edit Custom Role drawers, table labels, and Permissions Matrix column headers to resolve dynamically based on the active workspace industry (e.g. Real Estate vs Photography Studio) using $is_studio_mode.

2.9.68

  • Workspace Member Retrieval & Multi-Agency Query Resolution: Fixed branch key normalization and lookup mappings in User Management grid for standard and numeric branch IDs, and bypassed filtering restrictions for Workspace Owners to ensure all members and invitations render correctly.

2.9.67

  • Missing Script Tag Fix in Auth Templates: Restored omitted opening <script> tags in authentication and invitation layout templates (setup-account, register, forgot-password, reset-password) preventing raw script source from leaking into the UI.

2.9.66

  • Workspace Member Retrieval & Multi-Agency Query Resolution: Standardized user query resolution to handle multiple agency identifiers (integer IDs, slug keys, and agency_ prefixes) and bypassed branch filtering for Workspace Owners. Added role and tenant bypass checks to database query functions (leads, clients, properties, bookings, ledger, invitations) so all member records render correctly.

2.9.65

  • Tenant-Scoped Geofenced Attendance & Office Locations: Scoped geofencing settings dynamically to cora_office_address_{agency_id} to prevent cross-tenant settings overwrites and restored office coordinates/address lookup mapping in settings drawer.
  • Custom Roles Access Control & Dynamic Sidebar: Enabled custom roles management for workspace owners, enforced capability verification server-side, and dynamically filtered sidebar navigation menus based on permission matrix.

2.9.64

  • Detect Current Location Option: Integrated a location-detect button (crosshair icon) into the geofencing address input inside the Office Location side drawer. Uses the browser's Geolocation API to fetch GPS coordinates, update the live map, and perform reverse-geocoding via OpenStreetMap's Nominatim API to resolve street addresses automatically.

2.9.63

  • Syntax Error Fix for Global Actions: Resolved an unclosed bracket syntax error in copyAttendanceShareLink() that caused JavaScript compilation to fail and froze the UI on the members page.

2.9.62

  • Drawer Trigger Position, Interaction & Global Event Binding Fixes: Standardized side drawer sheets for User Editing, Custom Role Editing, and Attendance Reports. Added inline style overrides to force correct flex display, visibility, and transition states on open/close events by removing translate-x-full and pointer-events-none. Bound all user administration and geofencing inline event handlers (like radius, mode, save, mobile filters) to the global window object, preventing undefined function reference errors during table actions.

2.9.60

  • User Management Drawer Accessibility & Inline Binding Fixes: Standardized side drawer sheets for User Editing, Custom Role Editing, and Attendance Reports. Added inline style overrides to force correct flex display, visibility, and transition states on open/close events on open/close events. Bound all user administration inline event handlers to the global window object, preventing undefined function reference errors during table actions.

2.9.59

  • Geofenced Attendance Drawer Fix: Fixed window-level global binding and added inline style resets for the Office Geofencing and Map Settings side drawer, ensuring it opens immediately on click and animates smoothly.

2.9.58

  • User Management & Member Life-Cycle Engine: Multi-branch & office location binding in invite drawer, user status controls (active/suspended/pending) with real-time AJAX toggles, and user activity audit logging.
  • Custom Roles & Dynamic Capability Matrix: Interactive capability matrix for custom role creation per agency with granular module access controls.
  • Geofenced Attendance & Office Locations: Haversine distance GPS geofencing, IP whitelist verification, and Office Location setup with real-time punch popover integration.
  • Automated Evening Owner Summary Email & SMTP Relay: Hostinger Business SMTP email dispatch with automated daily 8 PM attendance summary reports for Workspace Owners.
  • Super Owner Governance & Universal Search: Added Attendance & Governance control tab in Super Admin Panel with global daily report dispatch, Cmd+K search modal with indexing across Users, Roles, Attendance Logs, and Office Locations.

2.9.57

  • User Management & Member Life-Cycle Engine: Multi-branch & office location binding in invite drawer, user status controls (active/suspended/pending) with real-time AJAX toggles, and user activity audit logging.
  • Custom Roles & Dynamic Capability Matrix: Interactive capability matrix for custom role creation per agency with granular module access controls.
  • Geofenced Attendance & Office Locations: Haversine distance GPS geofencing, IP whitelist verification, and Office Location setup with real-time punch popover integration.
  • Automated Evening Owner Summary Email & SMTP Relay: Hostinger Business SMTP email dispatch with automated daily 8 PM attendance summary reports for Workspace Owners.
  • Super Owner (Shruti) Governance & Universal Search: Added Attendance & Governance control tab in Super Admin Panel with global daily report dispatch, Cmd+K search modal with indexing across Users, Roles, Attendance Logs, and Office Locations.

2.9.56

  • Dynamic Tenant Canvas Site Routing & Workspace Isolation: Verified dynamic public site URL access (/site/{workspace_slug}) and confirmed user invitation drawer functionality.

2.9.55

  • Dynamic Tenant Canvas Site Routing & Workspace Isolation: Verified tenant dynamic URL access (/site/{workspace_slug}) for public Canvas web pages and confirmed invite user side drawer sheet functionality.

2.9.54

  • Hostinger SMTP Mail Relay & Nonce-Secured AJAX Email Handler: Implemented cora_send_email AJAX handler using WordPress wp_mail() configured with Hostinger Business SMTP (smtp.hostinger.com:465 SSL). Secured with dual nonce verification (getAjaxNonce()), active user checks, and HTML-formatted email delivery. Integrated with email compose form in Email Automation view with real-time log activity tracking.

2.9.53

  • Managed Hostinger SMTP Mail Relay & Access Lock: Pre-configured platform Hostinger Business SMTP mail server (smtp.hostinger.com:465 SSL, heycora@claraverse.in) in default settings. Made SMTP settings fields read-only with a System Locked badge and administrator indicator to protect email dispatch reliability while preserving on-demand connection testing.

2.9.52

  • Automatic WP Page Provisioning: Enhanced zero-latency cora_ajax_ensure_wp_post handler in Canvas Builder to automatically provision WordPress Page posts before launching Elementor iframe editor.
  • Elementor Visual Builder Integration: Fixed visual site editing workflow inside Canvas builder with seamless post provisioning and double-click modal trigger.

2.9.51

  • Automatic WP Page Post Provisioning: Implemented zero-latency cora_ajax_ensure_wp_post handler in Canvas Builder that detects unprovisioned pages (wp_post_id = 0) and instantly creates underlying WordPress Page posts on demand before opening the editor iframe.
  • WordPress Admin Shell Redirect Protection: Enhanced Canvas iframe error observer to catch WP Admin shell redirects (edit.php) and display clear direct builder options with double-click modal controls.

2.9.50

  • Canvas Elementor 403 Security Interception: Resolved iframe security restrictions preventing Elementor from loading inside Canvas site builder tab. Added automatic error observer that intercepts 403 preview errors and presents clean monochromatic direct editor fallback card with double-click modal trigger.
  • Visual Builder Workspace Isolation: Integrated direct elementor editor links for full-screen site page creation without iframe embedding blocks.

2.9.49

  • Dynamic Frontend Routing: Added multi-tenant dynamic frontend routing for Canvas website builder (/site/{workspace_slug} and /{workspace_slug}/site) with tenant agency_id scoping.
  • Canvas Builder Resolution: Updated Canvas Theme Builder 'View Site' and 'Preview Site' buttons to render live public URLs seamlessly.
  • Compatibility: Enforced full fallback compatibility for default sites and homepage rendering.

2.9.48

  • PWA Service Worker Canvas Bypass & Force Cache Purge: Added explicit service worker bypass rules for all public Canvas site URLs (/site/*) to prevent admin PWA offline fallback screens (Workspace Connection Idle) from intercepting public customer site traffic. Upgraded cache strategy to cora-workspace-v5 with auto cache purging on connection retry.

2.9.47

  • Canvas Front-End Template & Header Isolation: Isolated front-end Canvas theme rendering into clean standalone document flow with custom head scripts, dark/light theme tokens, and dynamic page metadata, preventing header leakage and recursive loading while serving public dynamic tenant URLs.

2.9.46

  • Canvas Router 504 Recursion Fix: Fixed visual builder page output handling by adding explicit exit; call after HTML rendering and replaced recursive template-loader.php inclusion inside template_redirect hook with non-recursive $wp_query state updates. Prevents Gateway Timeout (504) and infinite execution loops on front-end Canvas site routes.

2.9.45

  • Dynamic Tenant Canvas Site Routing: Updated dynamic front-end Canvas website routing (/site/{workspace_slug} and /{workspace_slug}/site) with tenant-scoped agency resolution to serve live tenant Canvas pages safely without conflicting with admin dashboard subpages.

2.9.44

  • Dynamic Front-End Canvas Routing: Enabled dynamic public routing for custom Canvas themes across tenant workspace URLs (/site/{workspace_slug} and /{workspace_slug}/site).

2.9.43

  • Dynamic Tenant Canvas Site Routing: Implemented tenant-scoped front-end Canvas website routing (/site/{workspace_slug} and /site/{workspace_slug}/{page_slug}) to render tenant's live built Canvas web pages dynamically.
  • Preview & View Link Resolution: Updated Canvas Builder theme preview and view buttons to automatically output exact tenant workspace site URLs.

2.9.42

  • Invite User Drawer Fix: Fixed global JavaScript window binding for openInviteDrawer() and closeInviteDrawer() to ensure side drawer opens immediately upon clicking '+ Invite User' across all workspace views.
  • Dynamic Frontend URL Route Resolution: Verified dynamic URL route handling (/{workspace_slug}/users) and confirmed front-end accessibility across all tenant workspaces.
  • Multi-Tenant Database Architecture: Provisioned dedicated cora_tenants, cora_branches, cora_users, and cora_invitations database tables with auto-increment IDs, indexed foreign keys, and status columns for enterprise multi-tenancy.
  • Cross-Workspace User Memberships: Enabled a single user account (email) to belong to multiple independent tenant workspaces with isolated role definitions per workspace.
  • Single Primary Owner Enforcement: Enforced strict platform-wide single Workspace Owner rule per agency; rejected secondary owner invitations with clear transfer prompt.
  • Custom Roles & Permissions Engine: Built tenant-scoped custom roles engine with dynamic permission matrices saved per agency key.
  • Workspace Primary Owner Transfer: Implemented safe owner transfer AJAX pipeline to reassign primary ownership to another member.

2.9.40

  • Dynamic Workspace Slug Navigation: Refactored workspace slug handling to dynamically map tenant agency names to workspace URLs (e.g. /agency-name/dashboard) while maintaining multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Dynamic Sidebar Navigation: Updated all sidebar menu items to preserve the active tenant's dynamic URL slug across all pages.

2.9.39

  • Tenant-Aware Sidebar Branding: Fixed sidebar header title to dynamically display the logged-in user's actual onboarded business name instead of hardcoded default 'Cora Real Estate'.
  • Tenant Workspace Isolation: Hidden the global 'Create New Workspace' popover button for standard tenant accounts, ensuring workspace isolation rules remain strictly enforced.
  • Dynamic Onboarding Sync: Onboarding step 2 business setup now immediately sets tenant agency metadata and syncs workspace context upon workspace activation.

2.9.38

  • Dynamic Workspace Data Isolation: Eliminated all excessive fallback mock data across every module. Reduced all fallback/seed arrays (Vault documents, Review requests, Crew shifts, Equipment gear, Leads imports) to single-item minimal samples, ensuring fresh tenant workspaces launch clean without phantom dummy records.
  • Neutral Staff Name Fallbacks: Replaced hardcoded staff names in crew scheduler resolution with generic 'Team Member' defaults.
  • Financial KPI Accuracy: Removed hardcoded ₹95,000 receivables fallback from Financial Overview; empty workspaces now correctly display ₹0.

2.9.37

  • Enhanced Clean SaaS Platform Mode: Hides tenant-level operations (such as Brokerage Operations CRM, Task Managers, Team Schedulers, and sidebar Industry/Role Switcher widgets) globally across all workspace slugs when logged in as the Super Owner (Shruti) to keep platform administration completely clean.
  • Auto-Redirect Super Owner to Control Center: Automatically overrides the default workspace dashboard page to load the Platform Control Center view directly for Super Owner accounts.

2.9.36

  • Clean SaaS Platform Mode: Hides tenant-level operations (such as Brokerage Operations CRM, Task Managers, Team Schedulers, and sidebar Industry/Role Switcher widgets) when operating in the Platform Control Center global view (super slug). Provides a pristine, unified view dedicated strictly to global administration.

2.9.35

  • Platform Control Center Menu Integration: Added a dedicated Platform Administration section to the sidebar navigation menu, giving Super Admins direct, one-click access to the Control Center to manage tenant workspaces and user accounts.

2.9.34

  • Multi-Tenant Workspace Isolation: Refactored database querying and role checks to support strict multi-tenancy. Restricted Super Admin (God mode) access exclusively to Shruti (dravya.shravya@gmail.com). Created automated workspace and default branch provisioning during self-registration and onboarding business details setup. Isolated lead databases, branches, and team members per tenant.

2.9.33

  • Onboarding & Updates Accordion Release: Checked that users have completed onboarding before they can access any standard workspace dashboard views. Added secure /workspace/onboarding step routing to collect business details, select the active business industry (Real Estate, Photography Studio, or Custom Workspace), and automatically provision clean database tables. Transformed the Software Updates view inside Settings Suite with dynamic timeline accordions, featuring expandable/collapsible logs per version, thin SVG chevron vectors, update status badges, and dynamic JavaScript click animations.

2.9.32

  • Comprehensive Symbol Collision Shield: Wrapped all 474 top-level function declarations in defensive function_exists() guards. Eliminates all possible PHP Cannot redeclare fatal errors regardless of co-installed plugins. Zero-downtime guarantee on activation.
